headline: The packaging check matches the container user the image declares
summary: The script that verifies a pulled image asserted the container user by name while the image declares it by id, so it rejected every image. The binaries and the image contents are unchanged from v1.1.1.

items.title: The packaging check accepts the image's numeric user
items.body: scripts/docker-smoke.sh verifies a pulled image: its labels, volumes, environment defaults, entrypoint error path and non-root identity. The image declares its user as 1000:1000, so that a host mounting /config and /data matches ownership by id without reading the image's passwd file, but the check still compared against the name hermit and failed with "expected User=hermit, got 1000:1000". It now asserts the numeric form, and separately confirms that hermit still carries uid and gid 1000 inside the image, so a base image that renumbers the account is caught here rather than at a volume mount.

items.title: The image is identical to v1.1.1 apart from the version it reports
items.body: Nothing in the runtime, the vendored framework or the base images moved. Operators already on v1.1.1 gain nothing by pulling this one. It exists so the packaging check runs against a release whose own copy of the script is the corrected one.
